h: Round the course, round the city
p: Golf Fang is an adults-only, 18+ venue, so this is very much a night out rather than a family afternoon. The secret to a good round is a gentle touch. Most people overhit their first few putts, so take your time, look at the angles and let the ball roll. If you're struggling, aim to leave yourself a short second shot rather than going for glory every time.

Keep things fun for everyone by agreeing teams, forfeits and side bets early on. One trusted scorekeeper avoids arguments, and a steady pace keeps the next groups happy. If it's someone's birthday or leaving do, have a word with the team when you book in case they can help make it a bit special.

Sheffield has plenty to fill a weekend. The Winter Garden in the city centre is a huge glasshouse filled with plants from around the world, and right next door the Millennium Gallery has art, design and Sheffield's famous metalwork collection. Kelham Island is the go-to area for independent pubs, breweries and food, and the Kelham Island Museum tells the story of the city's steel industry, including a mighty working steam engine. The Supertram runs through the city, making it easy to get about, and Sheffield's Botanical Gardens are a lovely calm spot for the morning after. With the Peak District right on the doorstep, you could even finish your weekend with a walk in the hills.
